}}{{recipe}}

'''Sloppy joes''' are loosemeat sandwiches that have roots in the cuisine of the Midwestern United States.

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) ground [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
*¼ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]] (optional)
*¼ cup chopped green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]] (optional)

==Procedure==
#Brown the ground beef, onions, and peppers in [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] on medium heat.
#Drain the liquid from the mixture.
#Place the ground beef back on the skillet.
#While on medium heat mix in the ketchup, barbecue sauce, garlic powder, and chili powder in any order.
#[[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] for 20 minutes.
#Serve over sliced, toasted hamburger buns.
